Bayt Al Ghaf has free wi-fi: Free guest Wi-Fi (network “BaytAlGhaf-Guest”, password printed on the menu).
Bayt Al Ghaf has prayer room: Prayer room for men and women on the first floor of the Heritage Quarter building (shared facility).
Bayt Al Ghaf has takeaway collection counter: Takeaway collection counter at the Al Seef Street entrance (Heritage Quarter Gate 3), with a 10-minute drop-off bay.
Bayt Al Ghaf has live oud music: Live oud music on Friday evenings, 20:00–22:00.
Bayt Al Ghaf has high chairs: Six high chairs; up to four per booking.
Bayt Al Ghaf has accessible restroom: Step-free accessible restroom on the ground floor, with a baby-changing table.
Bayt Al Ghaf has public parking: Paid public parking along Al Seef Street and in the Al Seef multi-storey car park, about 3 minutes' walk.
Bayt Al Ghaf has valet parking: Valet at Gate 3, 18:00–24:00 on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, AED 40 paid to the operator.
Bayt Al Ghaf has creek terrace: Outdoor creek terrace, open 15 October to 30 April, weather permitting.
Bayt Al Ghaf has private majlis rooms: Two private majlis rooms with floor seating: Majlis Al Sidr (6–10) and Majlis Al Ghaf (10–20).

Bayt Al Ghaf can be reached by car: From Sheikh Zayed Road, take Exit 50 towards Al Mankhool / Bur Dubai, follow Khalid Bin Al Waleed Road (Bank Street) towards Al Ghubaiba, then turn right onto Al Seef Street.
Bayt Al Ghaf can be reached by taxi or ride-hailing: Ask for “Al Seef, Heritage Quarter, Gate 3, near Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood”.

Bayt Al Ghaf can be reached by dubai metro: Take the Green Line to Al Fahidi Metro Station. Use the exit towards Al Fahidi Street / Al Seef and walk north-east towards the creek for about 10 minutes, passing the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood on your left.
Bayt Al Ghaf can be reached by bus: Several RTA bus routes stop at the Al Ghubaiba Bus Station and on Al Fahidi Street; from either stop the restaurant is a 10–12 minute walk along the creek.

Bayt Al Ghaf can be reached by abra or water taxi: From Deira, take a traditional abra from Deira Old Souq Abra Station across the creek to Bur Dubai Abra Station (a few minutes, paid in cash or with a Nol card), then walk about 12 minutes south-east along the creek promenade.

Bayt Al Ghaf can be reached by on foot: From the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood, walk towards the creek and turn left along the Al Seef promenade; we are the coral-stone building with the brass ghaf-tree sign, about 5 minutes away.
Bayt Al Ghaf is about 400 m from Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood (Al Bastakiya), 5 minutes on foot.

Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Alcohol: Bayt Al Ghaf is an alcohol-free restaurant. Alcohol is not served and may not be brought in.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Halal: All meat and poultry are halal. No pork or pork products are used anywhere in the kitchen.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Smoking, vaping and shisha: No smoking, vaping or shisha anywhere in the restaurant or on the terrace.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Dress code: Smart casual. Modest dress is appreciated, in keeping with the heritage quarter.

Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Children: Children are very welcome. High chairs are available (6 in total) and can be requested with a reservation. There is no separate children's menu; half-portion requests are handled by the team on the day for selected rice dishes.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Pets: Pets are not permitted inside or on the terrace. Assistance dogs are welcome.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Outside food and celebration cakes: Outside food and drink are not permitted, except a celebration cake with prior notice (a plating fee of AED 30 applies).
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Photography: Personal photography is welcome. Professional shoots require written permission from the management.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Allergen policy: One shared kitchen; no dish is guaranteed free from any allergen; severe allergies should speak to the duty manager.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Changing an order: Orders can be changed until 30 minutes before the pickup or delivery time, or until preparation starts.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Cancelling an order: Cancellation is free until the kitchen starts preparing the order.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Complaints: Missing or incorrect items are reported within 24 hours by phone or WhatsApp with the order number.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Refunds: Card payments are refunded to the original card through the restaurant's terminal; cash as cash or a credit note.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Catering: Orders above 20 portions are catering orders with notice periods, discounts and deposits.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Table time: Tables are booked for 90 to 180 minutes depending on party size.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Large groups: Groups of 13–20 are confirmed by phone; larger groups go to the events team.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Changing a reservation: Reservations can be changed until 2 hours before.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Cancelling a reservation: Cancellation is free; less than 2 hours before counts as a late cancellation.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Late arrival: Tables are held 15 minutes after the booking time.
Bayt Al Ghaf policy — Personal details and look-ups: Bookings and orders are discussed only with the reference and the phone number used.
